VBO:0200367.summary: Cockachons can enjoy close company while showing different levels of bustle. Reggie, a grown rescue, was relaxed with other dogs, shared his toys and treats, and liked curling in a sofa blanket. Ginger loved cuddles, sniffing walks and greeting neighbours; energetic Toby delighted in noisy stuffed toys.
